name: branding-twenty-white-geometric-logos-on-blue-glow
title: Twenty white icon-style logos on a navy field with a blue glow
whatItIs: A 5x4 grid of white symbols on a dark navy background with a blue glow at the lower right: a padlock face, arrows, tooth house, shield A, letter marks, leaf shield, wallet, music note, lightning bolt, houses and more, all built from simple geometry and negative space.
whatItMeans: Crisp and versatile; white marks on a glow show the range of a logo designer.
techniques: Show all marks reversed on one dark field.
Use negative space to hide a second meaning in each mark.
Add a coloured glow for depth.

vocabulary.definition: A logo containing two ideas in one shape.
A logo in white on a dark field.
An evenly spaced set of icons.
A soft coloured bloom in the background.
